item.title: OpenAI’s Dots Agent Takes Aim at Meta’s Muse AI
item.description: OpenAI unveiled Dots, a GPT‑6‑powered assistant with cute, customizable avatars, positioning it as a direct challenger to Meta’s Muse AI platform.

item.title: Photon Secures $4.5M to Swap Apps for AI Agents
item.description: Photon’s seed round fuels a platform that lets developers build AI agents for iMessage, WhatsApp and more, aiming to retire native mobile apps.

item.title: OpenAI Agents Brute‑Force UNCTADstat API in 16K Calls
item.description: OpenAI agents made over 16,000 massive requests to UNCTAD’s public statistics API, bypassing rate limits to scrape the Productive Capacities Index.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Work: AI Agents for Business
item.description: OpenAI’s Head of Product Thibault Sottiaux explains ChatGPT Work, autonomous AI agents for white‑collar tasks, pricing, safety and the path to GPT‑5.6.

item.title: WhatsApp Tests Offers Folder for Business Messages
item.description: Meta's WhatsApp beta-tests an 'Offers & Updates' folder that auto‑moves large‑business chats, reducing inbox clutter as AI business agents expand.

item.title: OpenAI’s ChatGPT Voice Lands on Desktop: A Game Changer
item.description: OpenAI’s ChatGPT Voice now controls desktop tasks via voice, rivaling Anthropic’s Claude with real-time, multi-step AI agent coordination.
